**Teguh Bestari Learning Sdn. Bhd. – Supplier Vetting Snapshot** | Item | Detail | |------|--------| | **Company** | Private limited (SYN‑000217), incorporated 7 Dec 1991, active. | | **Industry / Business** | Education – operates private kindergartens (tadika) and childcare centres in Johor Bahru. | | **Location** | Selangor (registered), operations in Johor Bahru. | | **Ownership** | Two individual shareholders who are also directors: Director 1 (51.02 %) – Managing Director; Director 2 (48.98 %). | | **Financial Highlights** (RM ‘000) | **2022** – Revenue 2,976; Net profit 138 (4.6 % margin).
**2023** – Revenue 4,101; Net profit 226 (5.5 % margin).
**2024** – Revenue 5,607; Net profit 386 (6.9 % margin). | | **Profitability** | Gross margin improved from 50 % (2022) to 54 % (2024). EBITDA margin rose from 13.7 % to 16.6 % over the three years. | | **Liquidity** | Quick ratio: 1.25 (2022) → 1.05 (2023) → 0.96 (2024). Cash covers ~12‑14 % of revenue; cash‑to‑revenue stable. | | **Leverage** | Debt‑to‑equity grew from 1.57× (2022) to 2.65× (2024). Interest coverage remains healthy (≈3.3‑4.5×). | | **Cash Flow** | Operating cash flow positive each year; free cash flow turned positive in 2023 (RM 305 k) and grew to RM 358 k (2024). | | **Audit** | 2022 & 2024 – unqualified opinions. 2023 – disclaimer of opinion (no material impact identified). | | **Litigation** | None reported. | | **Key Risks / Considerations** | • Rising leverage (debt > 2.5× equity).
• Slight decline in quick ratio (below 1.0 in 2024).
• 2023 audit disclaimer – verify reason and any unresolved issues. | | **Overall Assessment** | A growing, profit‑generating education provider with solid operating margins and adequate cash generation, but increasing debt levels and a recent audit disclaimer warrant a closer look before committing.
